problem: The scope classifier demands implementation tasks even though completed-export obligations and exclusions already bound product behavior, so change owners are pushed to prescribe work too early.
outcome: The scope classifier accepts completed-export status obligations and product-capability exclusions as sufficient scope input without requesting implementation tasks.
acceptance: Any failed export record makes its completed batch result failure and an all-success export reports success
Completed-export obligations and product exclusions are accepted without any implementation task being requested or used as scope evidence
